name: XSS via rich-text paste depends on DOMPurify config + CSP

input.title: Rich-text paste can include if DOMPurify is misconfigured
input.summary: DOMPurify default config blocks onerror. CSP header sets img-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'. Need to verify deployment's exact DOMPurify build + CSP overrides.

rationale: Needs deployment-specific verification of DOMPurify version + CSP policy. Stays needs_validation until verified.
